title: Ukraine foils Russia’s ‘Bear’s Corner’ encirclement plan in Kharkiv region – military spox
summary: Russian forces were already reporting the success of their ‘Bear’s Corner’ operation in the Kharkiv region before they had even launched it.

title: UK to provide £9.5 mln for construction of wind farm in Ukraine
summary: The United Kingdom will provide £9.5 million (nearly $12.5 million) to support the construction of a new 200 MW wind farm in Ukraine.

title: SSU detains serviceman suspected of guiding Russian strikes at Ukraine’s Defense Forces in Donetsk region
summary: The military counterintelligence unit of the Security Service of Ukraine (SSU), with the assistance of the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, has detained a serviceman in the Donetsk region suspected of providing Russia with the coordinates of Ukrainian Defense Forces units and military facilities.

title: 20 tonnes of medicines and medical equipment arrive in Zakarpattia from Hungary
summary: A consignment of medicines and medical equipment from Hungary has arrived in the Zakarpattia region.

title: Lithuania calls for Russia’s GRU to be designated terrorist organization
summary: The Main Directorate of the General Staff of the Russian Armed Forces (GRU) should be recognised as a terrorist organisation by the European Union, as this intelligence service ‘terrorises’ the populations of European countries.

title: 1,200 civilians remain in Druzhkivka community in Donetsk region
summary: There are still 1,200 civilians in the Druzhkivka urban territorial community in Donetsk region, and due to the extremely difficult security situation, evacuations from the area have almost come to a halt.

title: Enemy attack sparks warehouse fire in Bila Tserkva district
summary: In the Bila Tserkva district, a fire has broken out in a warehouse following an enemy attack; emergency services are on the scene.

title: Russian drone attack on Kremenchuk injures two
summary: In Kremenchuk, in the Poltava region, a 55-year-old woman and a 17-year-old girl were injured as a result of Russian shelling.

title: Russian strike hits infrastructure in Zhytomyr region, leaving people injured
summary: Russian forces attacked an infrastructure facility in the Malyn community of the Zhytomyr region.

title: Ukrainian border guards reporting no unusual incidents or provocations from Belarus – SBGS spox
summary: Ukrainian border guards are not observing any enemy activity near the country’s border with Belarus.

title: Russian secret services fabricating cases against civilians in occupied Kherson region to meet targets
summary: Russian secret services in the temporarily occupied part of the Kherson region continue to fabricate charges against local residents to meet performance targets.

title: Russian strike on enterprise in Nizhyn kills two, injures four
summary: Russian forces struck an enterprise in the city of Nizhyn, Chernihiv region. A man and a woman were killed in the attack, and four people were injured.

title: Ukrainian forces strike Russian oil facilities, defense industry plants, military airfields over past week
summary: This week, the Ukrainian Defense Forces struck Russian oil facilities, plants involved in explosives production and other facilities supporting the war effort, as well as military airfields and aircraft.

title: Liberian Foreign Minister makes first-ever visit to Kyiv
summary: Liberia’s Minister of Foreign Affairs, Sara Beysolow Nyanti, has arrived in Ukraine for her first official visit.

title: Secretary General of the Council of Europe arrives in Kyiv
summary: Secretary General of the Council of Europe Alain Berset has arrived in Kyiv for a visit during which he will meet with Ukraine’s leadership.

title: Russian strikes hit railways and energy infrastructure in nine Ukrainian regions overnight – PM Koretskyi
summary: Russian forces targeted infrastructure, industrial facilities and residential buildings in nine Ukrainian regions overnight on November 27, leaving one person dead and at least six others injured.

title: Zelensky: Ukraine will defend Kyiv by any means as Russia seeks to drive people from cities
summary: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky said Russia aims to force people to flee cities, including Kyiv, but assured that the Defense Forces would defend the capital by any means necessary. Without a capital, he stressed, there would be no country.

title: Russian aggression claims 777 children's lives in Ukraine
summary: A total of 777 children have been killed in Ukraine as a result of Russian military actions since the start of the full-scale invasion.

title: Explosions rock Russian plant producing components for Iskander missile fuel
summary: Drones attacked the Russian city of Yefremov in the Tula region overnight on November 27, with explosions reported near a local synthetic rubber plant.

title: Business support, affordable mortgages: Ukraine, World Bank sign agreements worth $676 mln
summary: Ukraine's Ministry of Economy and Environment and the World Bank have signed three financing agreements worth $676 million to support Ukrainian businesses and expand access to affordable mortgage lending.

title: War update: 136 clashes on front line over past day, two sectors see fiercest fighting
summary: A total of 136 combat engagements took place between the Ukrainian Defense Forces and Russian troops over the past day, with the heaviest Russian pressure concentrated on the Pokrovsk and Kostiantynivka sectors.

title: Russian attacks cause power outages in six regions, with Dnipropetrovsk and Kherson most affected
summary: Consumers in six Ukrainian regions remained without electricity as of the morning of November 27 following Russian attacks, with significant outages reported in the Dnipropetrovsk and Kherson regions.

title: Russian forces launch nearly 60 strikes on Sumy region in 24 hours, injuring one
summary: Over the course of 24 hours, from the morning of 26 November to the morning of 27 November, Russian invaders carried out nearly 60 strikes on 22 settlements in the Sumy region; one person was injured.

title: Air defences shoot down 110 of 155 Russian drones launched against Ukraine overnight
summary: Air defence forces shot down 110 drones used by the Russian army to attack Ukraine on the night of 27 November. Enemy strikes were recorded at 27 locations.

title: Russian strike hits petrol station in Kharkiv
summary: Russian troops have attacked a petrol station in Kharkiv.

title: Russian shelling of Dnipropetrovsk region kills one, injures several in more than 20 attacks
summary: Russian invaders have launched more than 20 further drone attacks on five districts in the Dnipropetrovsk region, resulting in damage, one fatality and two people injured.

title: Russia loses 2,262 more soldiers in war against Ukraine
summary: Between 24 February 2022 and 27 November 2026, Russian forces lost approximately 1,648,161 personnel, of whom 2,262 were lost in the last 24 hours.

title: Russian attacks on Izium injure six, damage homes and cars
summary: The enemy launched combined strikes on Izium, damaging houses and cars and causing fires; at least six people were injured.

title: Trump adds Ukraine to joint statement with NATO chief urging restraint in war escalation
summary: US President Donald Trump amended the wording of a joint statement with NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte on preventing the escalation of Russia’s war against Ukraine, adding that not only Russia but also Ukraine should refrain from such actions.

title: Attack on Zaporizhzhia sparks fire at factory building
summary: A fire broke out in a production building following an attack on an infrastructure facility in Zaporizhzhia.

title: Coffin to be installed in central Vienna in memory of Holodomor victims
summary: A symbolic coffin will be installed in central Vienna on November 28 in memory of the victims of the 1932–1933 Holodomor, to draw attention to the crimes of the Soviet regime and urge Austria to officially recognize the Holodomor as genocide of the Ukrainian people.
